name: Israel, Gaza & region
summary: Saudi Arabia intercepts missiles aimed at Riyadh on 8 Nov after strikes near Sanaa; Israeli attacks continue in Gaza
state: Saudi Arabia said it intercepted two ballistic and two cruise missiles aimed at Riyadh and the south on 8 Nov; debris damaged an Aramco building, with no casualties reported (AP). The coalition also reported a ballistic missile aimed at the Eastern region (Times of Israel). Houthi officials said Saudi strikes near Sanaa on 7 Nov killed at least 27, a figure not independently confirmed (AP). Medical sources told Anadolu that Israeli attacks killed two people in Gaza on 8 Nov, despite the ceasefire (Middle East Monitor). The Yemen–Saudi front sets the Alert; no Israeli strike on Lebanon was found for 8–9 Nov.
for_you: FCDO travel advice covers Saudi Arabia, Yemen, Israel, the Palestinian territories and Lebanon and is the reference for anyone travelling there. Flights to Saudi cities can be suspended at short notice, and civil defence alerts may be issued in affected areas.
